description: This file defines the ArticlesController class which handles HTTP requests related to articles, such as retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles in the ASP.NET Core web application. It utilizes MediatR for command/query dispatching and enforces authorization on modifying actions.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class managing HTTP endpoints for article operations using dependency injection for IMediator.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a list of articles with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a user's personalized article feed.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a single article identified by slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article; requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by slug; requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by slug; requires authorization.
